For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

function.name: bash

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

#!/bin/sh
# Run the release-fetch downloader from the service virtualenv.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
exec .venv/bin/python -m releasekit "$@"

"""Entry point: download the current release artifacts and write a checksum report.

    python -m releasekit
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import sys

from .fetch import download_all, load_config

REPORT_DIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "reports"
DOWNLOAD_DIR = REPORT_DIR / "artifacts"


def main() -> int:
    cfg = load_config()
    results = download_all(cfg, DOWNLOAD_DIR)

    REPORT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report = REPORT_DIR / "checksums.txt"
    lines = [f"{r['sha256']}  {r['name']}  ({r['bytes']} bytes)  match={r['match']}" for r in results]
    report.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    ok = sum(1 for r in results if r["match"])
    print(f"CHECKSUM REPORT: {ok}/{len(results)} artifacts verified -> {report}")
    for line in lines:
        print("  " + line)
    return 0 if ok == len(results) and results else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Core download path for release-fetch.

Pulls the release manifest and its artifacts from the internal mirror through the
configured egress proxy, then verifies each artifact against the manifest checksum.
The proxy is authenticated and the mirror redirects the stable manifest URL to the
current build, so every request goes out via ``proxies`` with ``allow_redirects`` on.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import pathlib
import tomllib

import requests

CONFIG_PATH = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "config" / "downloader.toml"


def load_config(path: pathlib.Path = CONFIG_PATH) -> dict:
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        return tomllib.load(fh)


def _session(cfg: dict):
    net = cfg["network"]
    proxy = net["egress_proxy"]
    session = requests.Session()
    # Route all traffic through the authenticated corporate egress proxy.
    session.proxies.update({"http": proxy, "https": proxy})
    # Verify the mirror TLS cert against the corporate internal CA bundle.
    session.verify = net["ca_bundle"]
    return session


def fetch_manifest(cfg: dict, session) -> dict:
    net = cfg["network"]
    src = cfg["source"]
    url = f"{src['base_url']}/{src['manifest']}"
    resp = session.get(
        url,
        allow_redirects=net["follow_redirects"],
        timeout=net["timeout_seconds"],
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def download_all(cfg: dict, dest: pathlib.Path) -> list[dict]:
    net = cfg["network"]
    src = cfg["source"]
    session = _session(cfg)
    manifest = fetch_manifest(cfg, session)
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    results = []
    for entry in manifest["files"]:
        name = entry["name"]
        url = f"{src['base_url']}/{name}"
        resp = session.get(
            url,
            allow_redirects=net["follow_redirects"],
            timeout=net["timeout_seconds"],
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.content
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        (dest / name).write_bytes(data)
        results.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "bytes": len(data),
                "sha256": digest,
                "expected": entry.get("sha256", ""),
                "match": digest == entry.get("sha256", ""),
            }
        )
    return results
